call_purpose: You came to us because some of your students say the lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones, and you hope it gets sorted out.

covered.text: We opened the lesson link you shared on a desktop in Chrome, in Safari and on a phone, and the video played each time, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side. This is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Ask one of your students to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.

support_next_steps.text: We will raise this with our technical team and get back to you. We could not give a timeline during the call, so we are not able to say when yet.

omitted_item_ids.reason: Already stated in call_purpose; repeating it would add no information
